title: 月梅圖（1978.49）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1978.49）
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「first half of the 1300s」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Andrew R. and Martha Holden Jennings Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → yuan；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Dubosc, Jean-Pierre. “Plum Blossoms in Moonlight: A Round Fan Painting Signed Yen Hui.” Archives of Asian Art, vol. 26, 1972, pp. 67–70.（Reproduced: pp. 67-70, fig. 2）
Lee, Sherman E. “The Year in Review for 1978.” The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art, vol. 66, no. 1, 1979, pp. 3–47.（Reproduced: cat. no. 149, p. 34; Mentioned: p. 5, p. 46）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Reproduced: cat. no. 9, p. 110）
Ortiz, Valérie Malenfer. Dreaming the southern song landscape: the power of illusion in Chinese painting. Leiden: Brill, 1999.（Reproduced: plate 57）

Fong, Wen, and Jerome Silbergeld, editor. Bridges to Heaven: Essays on East Asian Art in Honor of Professor Wen C. Fong. Princeton, NJ: P.Y. and Kinmay W. Tang Center for East Asian Art, Dept. of Art and Archaeology, Princeton University, 2011.（Reproduced: p. 71, fig. 4）
**馆方记录另有 2 条著录未在此列出。**

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**
